list: Official PS5 trophy list, frozen 2026-11-18 (Exophase / PSNProfiles, reported by Push Square)

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Finish all five chapters and enjoy the game. There are no mission medals and no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — the game gives you 15 manual slots plus one autosave. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends: it is the one interaction the guides flag as possibly missable. Scan vehicles and study animals as you go, and take optional missions when they appear; progress already counts toward the 100% checklist even before you can see it.
items: Save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots, 1 autosave)
Do Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends
Scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars as you travel
Take optional missions as they appear — quest givers stay available after the story

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist
roadmap.text: After the story, the 100% checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It is forgiving — roughly 60% true completion, not everything in the game. You need any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, every robbery, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 target decks, gold in all 42 shooting range challenges and wins at all 14 drone race locations. Nothing in it is missable; all of it can be done in free-roam after the story.
items: 100 optional missions (there are far more than 100 in the game)
200 of 277 vehicles scanned · 100 of 255 animals studied
Any 70 of 80 challenges — skip the hardest ones
All robberies, 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, 15 target decks

roadmap.title: Cleanup and the platinum
roadmap.text: Finish the Strangers & Freaks strands, the card sets and whatever miscellaneous trophies are left. Most of the list will already be done from stages 1 and 2. Leave cheats off for the whole run — the guides report that cheats switch off trophies and saving. When the last trophy pops, the platinum follows.
items: 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and the remaining card sets
Money trophies: laundering, spending and garages
Odd one-offs: the cocktail, the showroom, the bowling alley, the UFO line

notes: No online trophies: all 55 unlock in single-player.
No mission replay and no New Game Plus: manual saves are your only safety net.
Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off for a trophy run.
Five trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch and are marked unconfirmed in their guides.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing extra to do for it and no online or DLC trophy standing in the way — it is purely a reward for finishing the list. Plan the run in the three stages of the roadmap above and it will come naturally at the end.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play the first mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, to its end and the trophy pops with the mission complete screen. It is the opening mission of the game, so every player earns it within the first hour.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes and the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the one thing in this chapter that may not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play through Chapter 2 to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter closes and the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, starts. Chapter 2 is where the duo opens up — after the Coffee Break mission you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call your partner along, which several later trophies need.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3; the trophy pops once you have played the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where most of the robbery systems unlock — jewelry jobs, the key cloner and the fences — so spend time learning them here.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4; the trophy pops after its final mission, Starting From Zero. By this point the big bank vault robberies are open, and the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… is worth doing as soon as it appears, since it unlocks them.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed, and the second of the two golds. Play the story to its final mission and finish it; the trophy pops with the ending. Make a manual save before the final mission — there is no mission replay, and a fresh save here is the cleanest backup if you want to revisit the ending or its choices later.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It is a main story mission, so it comes to you in the natural order of the chapter — just keep playing the pink-marked main missions.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main story mission and unlocks in the normal flow of the chapter.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It is a main story mission, so it arrives in the chapter's normal order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It is a main story mission and pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is a main story mission in the chapter's normal flow.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a main story mission and the last of the chapter-named story trophies.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the first gold. After the story, the checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, every robbery, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 target decks, gold in all 42 shooting range challenges and wins at all 14 drone race locations. Nothing toward it is missable and everything can be finished in free-roam after the story, so treat it as the stage-2 goal and let the other trophies feed into it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute. You can mix the kinds freely, and flying under bridges is the quickest to rack up. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities — scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. Most of them arrive on their own from the story and the other trophies; if one is left, filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) and go to the nearest one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. The challenges are the same skill tested in different places, so practice the timing at one range and repeat it everywhere else; the guides report the golds as very doable. Golds here also raise your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total. You only need one win per location, not every race. Learn each course's racing line on the first attempt, then run it clean; the wins also count toward the race tally for Earn Cash, Not Kudos and toward Master of None.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Any 20 will do, so pick the shortest courses and the vehicle class you drive best, and repeat a win on a new course each time rather than re-running one you already won. Drone race wins count toward your race activity, but this trophy wants proper races — check the race map markers.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you about a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and it raises your Focus.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game — beating every side challenge is not required. Pick the game you find easiest and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3: Andy calls you, then texts her home address in Belville. Complete her five quests in order — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops at the end of the last one. The whole line stays available after the story, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It opens in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams: Kenton calls, then appears under the green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks treasure sites on the map and you dive for the loot — seven shipwrecks in total, using the metal detector on the ocean floor and bringing the finds back to his shop. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1, but he returns in Chapters 2 to 3 (calling Brian as Jason speeds it up), and the line stays open after the story. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests in order — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops at the end of the last one. The line stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but only certain questlines count. The game does not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie toward this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle at McKittrick Farm, Yago's street racing line and Pilot Pete's delivery line. More counting strangers are still being found, so check the linked guide for the latest confirmed list; all of them stay available in free-roam after the story. Watch the counter in the trophy list itself.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage, marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Scan cars with WAiNK to check if one is on the list, then drive it back — a car delivered in good condition pays more. The marked cars appear often in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and Randy marks new locations as you deliver. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show the Synthetic Labs around Vice City — go to them and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good; the trophy pops when it ends. Everything here stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the one trophy the guides flag. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The trap is Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation vanishes after Chapter 1 and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. The last spots need both characters together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until this is done.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His line is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. In that quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation). After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animal he asks for and bring it back to him. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck; all 15 target decks are needed for the 100% checklist anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in 18 set locations; you do not need every card in the game, just three full sets. Work through the card locations in the linked guide area by area, and tick sets off as you finish them — this is a relaxed cleanup trophy for stage 3.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up and then R1 while looking at them. There are more than 100 to find — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — and any 100 count, so just scan whatever you pass. Make it a habit from Chapter 1: a quick scan of every new street, statue and oddity you walk past will have this done long before the endgame.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. They come in eight categories of ten, and you can watch them under Progress, then Challenges — a checkmark in the bottom right shows which are done. Most of them finish on their own while you work on the other trophies, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy pops on the way. Leave it until late, then pick the easiest unfinished challenges to close it out.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when duo free-roam unlocks — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build four stars by causing carnage, then break out of the red heat area on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is an easy escape route, since the helicopter cannot see you on the tracks. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… and during bank vault robberies, which always trigger four stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the flashing wanted level must stay on the whole time, so do not let the heat drop between shops. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items and the back-room safe in each (break the safe with sticky bombs). The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to use it instantly) and scan vehicles by holding R1 while looking at them — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. The quickest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes; Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch, so variety is everywhere. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 scanned, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 and R3 together while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but the purple focus bar drains in seconds. Prepare first: eat or drink to buff focus, wash your face or shower at home, and take Adrenaline to stretch the slow-motion window. Then line up five enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556, wearing body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the run.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be connected to a boarding bridge; the planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the one at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, which lead through a door straight inside. Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane back to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it lands.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and shoot at the soldiers until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in, so bring armor and a fast getaway car for the approach.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door and use the Snap Gun to silently pick the lock (kicking the door sets the alarm off). Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. A reliable spot is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City. If you are spotted, leave and try another store — being seen is the only thing that blocks it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): it teaches the method — tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and the vault to open, then go in and rob it while your partner helps carry the cash (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip about security vans — he sells them once you have done his Payday Loans quests — and follow the purple van icons to the next banks. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles to break recognition. All 8 vaults are needed for the 100% checklist, and each one can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 optional mission that opens bank vaults — robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. To get it earlier, find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat zone. Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests, and Yasmani himself unlocks as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the whole map is visible. Work in a grid, coast to coast, and check the map after each pass to see what is left. It pairs naturally with the stunt flying and the vehicle scanning you are doing anyway.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy. There are 39 operations in total and all of them are needed for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no guide has a verified method yet. The description points to a bar on Ocean Beach: go there, order a cocktail and take in the view. The community is still pinning down which bar and which interaction triggers it, so check the linked guide for updates before spending long on it. It is a cleanup trophy for stage 3 either way.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no guide has a verified method yet. The description points to driving a car out through a vehicle showroom's front window, in the classic style of the old games. The community is still confirming which showroom and whether it needs a particular car or speed, so check the linked guide for updates. Mark it as a stage-3 cleanup trophy.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations — it is also marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, which you blow open with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while — you can go back and grab what is left, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always work out with both characters together — call your partner with Right plus Triangle. While one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength (the heart icon). Fitness clubs are all over Vice City — filter the map by Activities — and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. You can see the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and it helps to switch the notifications on under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile — a small demon face appears on screen whenever an action counts. Every robbery and enemy encounter feeds it, so it usually pops on its own while you work on the other trophies. The profile runs from Professional (stealthy, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid endless rampages: cops get far more aggressive and shoot on sight. If it is still short at the end, farm the last actions by running over civilians and cops with a car, then stop.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no guide has a verified method yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second try, and the current belief in the community is that it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Check the linked guide for updates as players confirm it, and treat it as a stage-3 cleanup trophy.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no guide has a verified method yet. The description hints at witnessing something strange, and the current belief in the community is that it comes from the UFO questline. Check the linked guide for updates as players confirm it, and treat it as a stage-3 cleanup trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no guide has a verified method yet. The description hints at knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and the current belief in the community is that it means kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle. Check the linked guide for updates as players confirm the exact move, and treat it as a stage-3 cleanup trophy.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder the bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative, so you do not need $250,000 in one trip, and it builds naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist — a single bank vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative and every shop counts. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops and tattoos at the 11 tattoo studios. Clothing stores, footwear, hair and beauty salons, electronics stores and Pay 'n' Sprays all count too. If you are already buying gear for the other trophies, much of this will be done without trying.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the four story-related garages do not count. Together they cost $160,000. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses; you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy through it. The quickest money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4. Each garage also adds parking spots, which you need for the Scooter Bros registrations in On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage — registered cars can then be delivered to your location anywhere. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Each garage you own adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes), and use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the registration fees down.
